newsitem.title: ESTONIA: BANK ASSETS REACH 25.6 BLN KROONS IN APRIL.
newsitem.headline: BANK ASSETS REACH 25.6 BLN KROONS IN APRIL.

text.p: The combined balance sheet of Estonia's commercial banks was 25.6 billion kroons in April compared to 24.8 billion kroons in March, a rise of 3.2 percent during the month, the central bank said on Friday.
The combined loan portfolio of Estonia's commercial banks increased by 0.8 billion kroons to 14.1 billion kroons in April, the central bank added in a statement.
Hansabank had the largest loan portfolio of 3.6 billion kroons, followed by Uhisbank's 3.4 billion kroons and Hoiubank's 3.35 billion kroons.
Deposits rose by 0.7 billion kroons from 15.3 billion kroons to 16 billion kroons in April.
Hoiubank had the largest share of deposits at over four billion kroons, followed by Hansabank's 3.8 billion kroons and Uhisbank's 3.7 billion kroons.
